column1: # Country names as they end an address, upper case without accents, words separated by single spaces: name, country code.
# The destination country is written in full on the last line of international mail (bpost Belgian template 3; La Poste guide p. 18; PostNL, Adressering internationale postzendingen).

# Group B. Country lines as the UPU sheets print them (United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Malta, San Marino "REP. OF SAN MARINO", Vatican, Andorra, Isle of Man) and the usual names in the languages of the neighbours. CI (Channel Islands) is the country line of Jersey and Guernsey (UPU Jersey and Guernsey sheets); the postcode decides which of the two.
UNITED KINGDOM OF GREAT BRITAIN AND NORTHERN IRELAND
